leads_no_state_excluded.note: Monthly 'New leads' = contacts created that month with a recognised AU/NZ state AND not an internal address. Excluded: (1) no recognised state (near-all spam/bot form-fills + legacy imports; country isn't collected on any form); (2) staff/self addresses (@wonderlandrv.com, anything with 'piyush'). None are real leads.

data_quality.deposits_handovers_method: From July 2026 these are counted from actual stage-change events (/dealActivities, dataType=d_stageid, cdate in month), deduped by chassis. The previous method (deals currently in the stage with mdate in the month) is unreliable: 47 Handover Complete deals were bulk-modified on 1-3 Aug 2026, which overwrote the July mdate signal and would have reported 0 deposits / 1 handover. Back-test on June: the event method returns 6 deposits (the 3 stored plus 3 VIC the mdate method missed) and 7 handovers vs 8 stored. Earlier months were left as recorded and are likely undercounted.
data_quality.configurator_submitters_correction: submitters_alltime recomputed as 66 (was 1826). The documented method GET /contactTags?filters[tag]=31 is silently ignored by the AC API and returns every contactTag row (24,584 across all tags). Verified correct filter: GET /contacts?tagid=31.
data_quality.deals_by_type_note: July uses the documented 5-bucket classifier (Ad enquiries / Configurator / Brochure downloads / Virtual consults / Other). Jan-Jun rows carry extra buckets (Campaign offers, Shows & events, Sales-entered / other) from an earlier undocumented classifier, so the type split is not directly comparable across the June/July boundary.
